sn11.8:1.1: Sāvatthi nidānam || || Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divā vihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Verocano ca asurindo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paccekadvārabāham nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || Atha kho Verocano asurindo Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn11.8:2.1: Vāyameth-eva puriso || yāva atthassa nippadā || nippannasobhaṇo attho || Verocanavaco idan ti || ||
sn11.8:3.1: Vāyameth-eva puriso || yāva atthassa nippadā || nippannasobhaṇo attho || khantyā bhiyyo na vijjatī ti || ||
sn11.8:4.1: Sabbe sattā atthajātā || tattha tattha yathārahaṃ || saṃyogaparamā tveva || sambhogā sabbapāṇinaṃ || nippannasobhino atthā || Verocanavaco idan ti || ||
sn11.8:5.1: Sabbe sattā atthajātā || tattha tattha yathārahaṃ || saṃyogaparamā tveva || sambhogā sabbapāṇinaṃ || nippannasobhino atthā || khantyā bhiyyo na vijjatī ti ||
